name: Home Assistant
description: Read entity states, call services, fire events and send phone notifications through Home Assistant

setup.title: Recommended Home Assistant Setup
items: A long-lived access token from a dedicated user
A user that can control only the entities the workflows need
setup.note: A long-lived access token has the full rights of its user. Create it in your profile page, under Security.

auth.label: Long-Lived Access Token
auth.hint: A long-lived access token. Create it on your Profile page > Security > Long-lived access tokens > Create token.

operations.label: API Status
operations.description: Check that the Home Assistant API is running

operations.label: Get State
operations.description: Get the state and attributes of one entity

operations.label: List States
operations.description: List the state of every entity

operations.label: Call Service
operations.description: Call a service. For a phone push, use domain notify and service mobile_app_<device>.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.description: Service domain, for example light or notify

inputs.name: service
inputs.description: Service name, for example turn_on or mobile_app_<device>

inputs.name: data
inputs.description: Service data, for example {"title": "Door", "message": "Front door open"}

operations.label: Fire Event
operations.description: Fire an event on the Home Assistant event bus

operations.label: Render Template
operations.description: Render a Home Assistant Jinja template and return the text

inputs.name: template
inputs.description: Jinja template, for example a states() call on a sensor
